name: PER_MASS_LINE_FUT_UPDATES
description: Stores summary of changed attribute values of different entities.

columns.name: MASS_ACTION_FUT_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key column.

columns.name: MASS_ACTION_LINE_ID
columns.description: The mass action line id associated to the surrogate key id.

columns.name: MASS_ACTION_HEADER_ID
columns.description: The mass action header id associated to one or more surrogate keys.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: The PersonId of the person whose attribute changes are stored.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: The enterprise id of the person.

columns.name: SURROGATE_KEY_ID
columns.description: Surrogate key of the entity whose attribute changes are stored.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: SURROGATE_KEY_NAME
columns.description: Surrogate key name of the entity whose attribute changes are stored.

columns.name: ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the entity whose attribute changes are stored..

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: The name of the attribute whose changed are stored.

columns.name: ACTION_OCCURRENCE_ID
columns.description: The ActionOccurrenceId of the entity row whose attribute changes are stored.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the order of different changes made during a day. The lowest value represents the earliest change in the day.

columns.name: OLD_VALUE
columns.description: The old value of the attribute that has changes in the source entity row.

columns.name: NEW_VALUE
columns.description: The new value of the attribute that has changes in the source entity row.

columns.name: COPY_STATUS
columns.description: This indicates whether the copy of the update is done or not done.

columns.name: DESTINATION_SURROGATE_KEY_ID
columns.description: Surrogate key of the entity into which the attribute change has to be copied.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
